description: Read the user's GetMattered account summary. It returns the plan name, tier, status and renewal or end date; the AI token balance; the applications used and left in the current 30-day window and when it resets, plus the free allowance on a free account; the job preferences matches are found against (target roles, locations, remote); readiness: whether a resume is on file, whether account setup is finished, and the names of the profile fields employer forms require that are still empty; the saved resumes (id, title, base flag, last update); the default apply mode and whether Auto Apply is on; and whether Gmail, Outlook and Indeed are connected, with the connected address. It never returns passwords, access tokens, payment card details or the answers saved in the application profile. Read-only: it changes nothing and spends no credits. Call it before applying to several jobs, or when the user asks what they have left. Do not use it to change anything; use getmattered_update_job_preferences, getmattered_update_application_profile, getmattered_set_resume or getmattered_update_automatic_apply_settings. Next: getmattered_set_resume when no resume is on file, otherwise getmattered_get_matches.
